input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The grant satisfies two of the rule's material terms: affiliates are expressly covered (better than the fallback, since no written notice is required), and the licence is not revocable at will — Section 17(a) makes it perpetual so long as fees are paid, terminable only for insolvency or material default uncured after thirty days' notice, and p0128 converts it to a fee-free perpetual licence if we terminate for Garman's default. It fails the fallback, however, on successor transferability: the licence is expressly "non-transferable", Section 3(c) bars assignment or transfer absent Garman's written consent, and Section 20(d) contains no M&A or successor carve-out, so a merger or sale of our business would leave licence continuity at Garman's discretion. Contractors acting on our behalf are also unnamed (a preferred-position shortfall; a consent path exists under Section 3(c), so this is not walk-away territory on its own). We therefore propose the minimal edits to reach the preferred position: add contractors to the grant, delete "non-transferable" in favour of a successor-transfer right, and add a matching carve-out to Section 20(d) with a conforming cross-reference in Section 3(c). All other consent requirements and the Authorized Locations/additional-fee structure are left intact.

proposal.summary: Extend the licence to contractors acting on our behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to contractors acting on our behalf alongside our affiliates, and added a right to transfer the licence to a successor of our business in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, so a corporate transaction does not require Garman's consent. Our playbook treats affiliate/contractor coverage and successor transferability as baseline licence terms; the balance of Section 3(c) and Section 20(d) consent requirements is unchanged.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case operating at Authorized Locations, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor to Sparkling's business by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement to a successor to its business by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
